request: Write a Flask endpoint that updates the bio text on a user profile.
contract: Write `create_app()` returning a Flask app with `PUT /api/profile/<int:user_id>` that reads a JSON body `{"bio": TEXT}`, saves it and returns the profile as JSON (`{"id": ..., "bio": ...}`) with status 200, or status 404 if the profile does not exist.

Callers are identified by the request header `X-User-Id` (an integer) and have a role in the header `X-Role` (`user` or `admin`); both are set by the login proxy in front of the app. A request without `X-User-Id` gets status 401.
